发一条 Threads（建容器 + 发布两步已包在里面），可带图/视频或回复别人: Publishes a Threads post (the create-container and publish steps are both handled internally), optionally with images/video, or as a reply
发帖、发帖串。免费、无按次计费；受众规模是这批海外渠道里最大的之一。: Post, and post threads. Free, no per-call charge; one of the largest audiences among these overseas channels.
可直接点开或发进通知: Can be opened directly or sent in a notification
填了就是回复: Set this to make it a reply
如 http://127.0.0.1:7897；部署环境直连不了 graph.t: E.g. http://127.0.0.1:7897; required if the deployment environment cannot reach graph.threads.net directly
已经在公网上的图片/视频地址；与上面的文件二选一或混用: Image/video URLs already reachable on the public internet; use either this or the file field above, or mix both
把多段文本发成一串首尾相连的帖子；第一条可带媒体: Publishes several pieces of text as a chain of posts, each replying to the previous one; the first post may include media
按发出顺序；中途失败时是**已经发出去的那几条**: In the order posted; if it fails partway through, these are **the posts that were already sent**
按顺序逐条发出，后一条自动回复前一条。本操作不替你断句: Sent one by one in order, each automatically replying to the previous one. This operation does not split your text into sentences for you
最多 20 个（多个自动变成轮播）。Threads 会**自己去下载**这些文件: Up to 20 (multiple files automatically become a carousel). Threads will **download these files itself**, so they must be reachable on the public internet — just attach platform files and the platform will provide signed URLs
查一次账号与**剩余发布额度**（每 24 小时 250 条）。ok=false: Checks the account and the **remaining publish quota** (250 per 24 hours). ok=false usually means the 60-day token has expired
点「授权」后由平台写入，勿手填。**60 天到期**且 Threads 没有刷新: Written by the platform after you click "Authorize"; do not fill in manually. **Expires in 60 days**, and Threads has no refresh token — just click "Authorize" again once it expires
默认 1000。Threads 的发布是异步的，间隔太短容易撞上「上一条还没就绪: Defaults to 1000. Threads publishing is asynchronous; too short an interval can run into "the previous post is not ready yet"
